name: VIATRIS INC.

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), Consolidated Statements of Operations and EPS note (Note 5): 'Weighted average shares outstanding — Diluted' 1,170.7M for FY2025, 1,193.3M for FY2024, 1,206.9M for FY2023 (in millions). EDGAR companyfacts carries no full-year diluted-share fact for FY2024/FY2025 under WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding (the loss-year counts, where diluted equals basic because share awards are anti-dilutive, are not carried in the aggregated facts).
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:shares — diluted shares missing for FY2024 and FY2025 of the last 3 fiscal years in EDGAR companyfacts. The filer's own FY2025 diluted weighted-average count from its FY2025 10-K fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period, so FY2024 OE/share is computed on 1,170.7M instead of its own filed 1,193.3M (overstates FY2024 OE/share by ~1.9%, disclosed in analysis.md) and FY2025 is exact. In FY2024/FY2025 diluted equals basic (net losses; anti-dilutive awards excluded — FY2025 EPS note: total dilutive shares 1,170.7M = basic 1,170.7M, share-based awards —).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-26), Consolidated Statements of Operations and EPS note (Note 5): 'Weighted average shares outstanding — Diluted' 1,170.7M for FY2025, 1,193.3M for FY2024, 1,206.9M for FY2023 (in millions). EDGAR companyfacts carries no full-year diluted-share fact for FY2024/FY2025 under WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding (the loss-year counts, where diluted equals basic because share awards are anti-dilutive, are not carried in the aggregated facts).); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 7.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
